newsitem.title: UK: Charterhouse takes 36 pct stake in Sheffield Weds.
newsitem.headline: Charterhouse takes 36 pct stake in Sheffield Weds.

text.p: Charterhouse Development Capital Funds has taken a 36 percent stake in English premier league soccer club Sheffield Wednesday after a placing and open offer or shares, the club said. Venture capital group Charterhouse had pledged to take a stake of between 20 and 40 percent depending on the demand from the club's 3,000 existing shareholders. Shareholders applied for 1.65 million shares at 85p each, at a total cost of 1.4 million stg. Charterhouse is investing 15.6 million stg in the club.
The 17 million stg raised will be used to buy players, improve facilities at the club's Hillsborough stadium and training ground and cut borrowings.

Wednesday chairman Dave Richards denied that the take up from existing shareholders had been disappointing, saying they had shown their loyalty to the premier league club with the size of their investment. He said that Charterhouse had always been prepared to acquire up to 40 percent of the club.
Wednesday, pushing for a place in next season's UEFA Cup, has said it does not plan to seek a stock market listing for two to three years.
